name: Tera Holding
verdict: Turkish finance-and-technology group, privately held by the Tezmen family; announced in August 2026 as back-of-shirt sponsor of Beşiktaş's football and men's basketball teams for two seasons from 2026-27.
note: Rating note: private company; main owner Emre Tezmen (tera-tezmen-ownership). Its chairman was put under a travel ban in September 2026 and Turkey's capital-markets regulator moved to liquidate Tera portfolio funds in the 'fund crisis' investigation — a financial record, which does not count under METHOD.md. No state stake and no human-rights finding against the company were found. Proposed tier: none. ON HOLD: proposed 'none' in PR, pending maintainer review.
